intro.speaker: INCIDENT COMMANDER
intro.text: CRITICAL INCIDENT: The new Green deployment is failing under load. You have 15 seconds to scale up the old Blue environment and rollback 100% of traffic before the system collapses.

success.speaker: INCIDENT COMMANDER
success.text: Incident resolved. Traffic is stable on Blue. Good job under pressure.

failure.speaker: INCIDENT COMMANDER
failure.text: System collapsed. You didn't scale Blue fast enough, or you shifted traffic to an unscaled environment.

targetMisconception: Rollbacks are a manual, slow process.
rules: Scale up the old Blue environment to handle 100% traffic (10 nodes)
Shift 100% of traffic from Green back to Blue
Complete the rollback before the time limit expires

engineerMode.artifact:
kubectl rollout undo deployment/green-app
# OR using a load balancer:
# Shift traffic weights back to blue service.

annotation.text: Kubernetes can instantly revert to the previous ReplicaSet.
